crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

translations.web: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
translations.bsb: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
translations.kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
translations.asv: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.
